newsitem.title: USA: Sullivan agrees with higher Q1 estimates.
newsitem.headline: Sullivan agrees with higher Q1 estimates.

text.p: Sullivan Dental Products Inc is comfortable with the First Call consensus earnings estimate of $0.18 per share for the first quarter, up from $0.15 a year ago, President and Chief Financial Officer Timothy Sullivan said Thursday.
"We're confortable with that," Sullivan told Reuters in an interview during a Mesirow Financial dental conference here.
He said the company is guiding analysts upward on their 1997 earnings estimates. He said the company is comfortable with 1997 estimates in the range of $0.98 to $1.05 per share.
The First Call consensus for 1997 is $0.96 per share.
The company earned $0.91 per share in 1996.
Sullivan Dental is comfortable with 1997 revenue estimates ranging from $265 million to $272 million, compared to $241.5 million in 1996, the executive said.
"We're very comfortable with that," he said.
